## Summary
A concise summary of the proposed feature or improvement.

## Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe.
Example: "I am always frustrated when inspecting developer caches for..."

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how you envision the user experience.

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you considered.

## Ecosystem / Toolchain Relevance
If this involves new developer artifact detection, specify:
- Target Ecosystem: [e.g., Elixir, Zig, Go, Haskell, Swift]
- Target Marker Files: [e.g., mix.exs, build.zig, go.mod]
- Target Cache / Build Directories: [e.g., _build, deps, .zig-cache]

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
